context.background: Finance enters the actual charges for a shipment at billing settlement, in a repeater labelled Vendor Lines. A line never records which vendor it came from, so the label pointed at nothing on screen.
context.reason: The PIC asked for the lines to be called Shipment Lines. The estimate beside them was renamed Estimated Charges so the comparison does not read as shipment against shipment.

source.note: PIC asked to rename the field, 7 Nov
audit, copy options, the change and this report
